app_info.subtitle: Transcribe and analyze media
app_info.description:
Speak AI transcribes and analyzes your interviews, sales calls, research sessions, webinars, podcasts, and team meetings.

This connector brings your Speak AI library into your AI assistant, so instead of scrubbing through hours of audio, you can simply ask questions and get answers.

Capture

Meeting assistant
Send a bot to your Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams calls to record, transcribe, and analyze them. Schedule ahead, join a live call, or remove it whenever needed.

Upload anything
Upload audio, video, or text. Get a transcript and AI insights back in the same thread.

Async surveys
Set up voice and video recorders with custom questions, share a link, and collect responses for research, candidate screens, customer feedback, or team check-ins.

Analyze

Multi-file analysis
Search and reason across thousands of recordings at once. Group customer feedback by theme, compare answers across interviews, or pull every mention of a topic with citations back to the source.

AI chat with your library
Ask follow-up questions, save favorite prompts, and keep a full chat history per recording or across your whole workspace.

Summarize and extract
Extract decisions, action items, owners, risks, sentiment, themes, and exact quotes from any conversation.

Act

Create
Create clips, highlights, captions, text notes, folders, custom fields, and embeds directly from chat.

Multi-step workflows
Chain actions together with automations and webhooks. Auto-tag new recordings, route insights to other tools, trigger follow-ups when a meeting ends, or run a custom prompt against every new upload.

Share & Organize

Share
Export answers, transcripts, captions, and clips. Generate embed links and shareable views to send insights to teammates or stakeholders without giving them access to your whole workspace.

Organize at scale
Bulk move media, update transcripts and speakers, manage folders and views, and clone setups across teams.

Who It's For

Speak AI is built for researchers, customer-success teams, meeting-heavy operators, and media and content workflows - anyone who records conversations and wants to stop re-listening to find what matters.

Privacy

Your recordings stay in your Speak AI workspace. The connector only queries them with the permissions you allow.

test_cases.description: List recent media in the Speak AI workspace.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Speak AI to list my 10 most recent media files with each file name, media ID, media type, processing state, and created date.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns up to 10 recent Speak AI media records with names, media IDs, media types, processing states, and created dates, or clearly states that no matching media was found.

test_cases.description: Search recordings and transcripts for pricing feedback.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Speak AI to search my media library for recordings or transcripts that mention pricing feedback. Return the most relevant matches with media IDs and short snippets or summaries.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant Speak AI search results for pricing feedback with enough source detail, such as media IDs, names, snippets, or summaries, for the user to open the recordings.

test_cases.description: Check processing status for a known media file.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Speak AI to check the processing status for media ID 8ab98de8cf13.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the current processing state for media ID 8ab98de8cf13, such as pending, transcribing, analyzing, processed, or failed, and does not invent transcript content.

test_cases.description: Retrieve a transcript for a known processed media file.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Speak AI to get the transcript for media ID 8ab98de8cf13. Include speaker labels and timestamps if Speak AI returns them.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the transcript data for media ID 8ab98de8cf13 with speaker and timestamp information when available, or reports the exact Speak AI processing/error state if the transcript is not available.

test_cases.description: Ask a focused AI question about one recording.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Speak AI to answer this question about media ID 8ab98de8cf13: What are the key decisions, action items, owners, risks, and notable quotes?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an AI answer grounded in media ID 8ab98de8cf13, organized around decisions, action items, owners, risks, and notable quotes, with source references when Speak AI provides them.

test_cases.description: Create a text note for analysis from user-provided text.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Speak AI to create a text note named OpenAI Review Test Note with this content: Customer A said onboarding was smooth, Customer B asked for clearer pricing, and Customer C wanted faster export workflows. Tag it openai-review-test.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a Speak AI text note from the provided text, returns the created media or note ID and initial analysis state, and explains that any AI analysis may complete asynchronously.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Speak AI for general web news.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Search the web for the latest OpenAI news and summarize the top stories.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The Speak AI app should not be invoked because the request is a general web search unrelated to the user's Speak AI workspace.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Speak AI for calendar scheduling without meeting-assistant intent.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Put a dentist appointment on my Google Calendar tomorrow at 2 PM.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The Speak AI app should not be invoked because the request is ordinary calendar scheduling and does not ask for a Speak AI meeting assistant.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Speak AI to directly transcribe unsupported external media.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Transcribe this YouTube video directly and give me the full transcript: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The Speak AI app should not be invoked unless the user asks to upload supported media to their Speak AI workspace; it should not claim to directly transcribe YouTube content outside Speak AI.
